input.quote: 15.11 Limitation of Liability. TO THE MAXIMUM EXTENT PERMITTED BY LAW AND NOTWITHSTANDING ANY PROVISION IN THIS AGREEMENT TO THE CONTRARY, NEITHER PARTY WILL BE LIABLE TO THE OTHER PARTY FOR ANY INDIRECT, INCIDENTAL, CONSEQUENTIAL, SPECIAL, RELIANCE OR PUNITIVE DAMAGES OR LOST OR IMPUTED PROFITS OR ROYALTIES OR COST OF PROCUREMENT OF SUBSTITUTE GOODS OR SERVICES
input.rationale: Section 15.11 is the only limitation-of-liability provision (Article 12 contains indemnities and insurance limits only, and Section 13.6 is a warranty disclaimer). It provides a mutual waiver of indirect/consequential damages and confirms PB's Article 6/14.2 payment obligations are not limited, but it contains no aggregate monetary cap at all, so each Party's direct liability is unlimited. That fails the fallback, which requires a mutual cap of at least 12 months' fees with carve-outs. We therefore added a mutual cap at the greater of twelve months' Article 6 payments and USD 1,000,000, with uncapped Excluded Claims (indemnification, confidentiality/data protection, gross negligence, willful misconduct, fraud, IP infringement) and preserved uncapped treatment of each Party's payment/funding obligations. The existing consequential-damages exclusion and payment-obligation carve-out are left intact.

proposal.summary: Add a mutual monetary cap with uncapped Excluded Claims to Section 15.11
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 15.11 waives consequential damages but leaves both Parties' direct liability entirely uncapped, so we added a mutual cap at the greater of twelve months' Article 6 payments and USD 1,000,000, consistent with our position that liability be capped for both sides at a meaningful amount. Indemnification, confidentiality/data protection, gross negligence, willful misconduct, fraud, IP infringement and each Party's payment/funding obligations sit outside the cap.

ops.oldText: FOR THE AVOIDANCE OF DOUBT, THIS SECTION 15.11 IS NOT MEANT TO LIMIT PB'S OBLIGATION TO PAY SFJ THE AMOUNTS SET FORTH IN ARTICLE 6 OR SECTION 14.2.
ops.newText: FOR THE AVOIDANCE OF DOUBT, THIS SECTION 15.11 IS NOT MEANT TO LIMIT PB'S OBLIGATION TO PAY SFJ THE AMOUNTS SET FORTH IN ARTICLE 6 OR SECTION 14.2. EXCEPT FOR EXCLUDED CLAIMS, EACH PARTY'S TOTAL AGGREGATE LIABILITY ARISING OUT OF OR RELATING TO THIS AGREEMENT WILL NOT EXCEED THE GREATER OF (A) THE AGGREGATE AMOUNTS PAID OR PAYABLE BY PB TO SFJ UNDER ARTICLE 6 IN THE TWELVE (12) MONTHS IMMEDIATELY PRECEDING THE EVENT GIVING RISE TO THE CLAIM AND (B) ONE MILLION DOLLARS USD ($1,000,000). "EXCLUDED CLAIMS" MEANS A PARTY'S BREACH OF ITS CONFIDENTIALITY OR DATA PROTECTION OBLIGATIONS UNDER ARTICLE 10 OR ARTICLE 11, ITS INDEMNIFICATION OBLIGATIONS UNDER ARTICLE 12, ITS GROSS NEGLIGENCE, WILLFUL MISCONDUCT OR FRAUD, ITS INFRINGEMENT OF THE OTHER PARTY'S INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY, AND ITS OBLIGATIONS TO MAKE PAYMENTS EXPRESSLY REQUIRED UNDER THIS AGREEMENT, INCLUDING PB'S OBLIGATIONS UNDER ARTICLE 6 AND SECTION 14.2 AND SFJ'S OBLIGATION TO FUND DEVELOPMENT COSTS UNDER ARTICLE 4.
